entries.title: Acts 8:1
segments: ¶Now Saul was consenting to his death. At that time a great persecution arose against the church which was at Jerusalem; and they were all scattered throughout the regions of Judea and Samaria, except the apostles.

entries.title: Acts 8:2
segments: And devout men carried Stephen [to his burial], and made great lamentation over him.

entries.title: Acts 8:3
segments: As for Saul, he made havoc of the church, entering every house, and dragging off men and women, committing [them] to prison.

entries.title: Acts 8:4
segments: ¶Therefore those who were scattered went everywhere preaching the word.

entries.title: Acts 8:5
segments: Then Philip went down to the city of Samaria and preached Christ to them.

entries.title: Acts 8:6
segments: And the multitudes with one accord heeded the things spoken by Philip, hearing and seeing the miracles which he did.

entries.title: Acts 8:7
segments: For unclean spirits, crying with a loud voice, came out of many who were possessed; and many who were paralyzed and lame were healed.

entries.title: Acts 8:8
segments: And there was great joy in that city.

entries.title: Acts 8:9
segments: But there was a certain man called Simon, who previously practiced sorcery in the city and astonished the people of Samaria, claiming that he was someone great,

entries.title: Acts 8:10
segments: to whom they all gave heed, from the least to the greatest, saying, "This man is the great power of God."

entries.title: Acts 8:11
segments: And they heeded him because he had astonished them with his sorceries for a long time.

entries.title: Acts 8:12
segments: But when they believed Philip as he preached the things concerning the kingdom of God and the name of Jesus Christ, both men and women were baptized.

entries.title: Acts 8:13
segments: Then Simon himself also believed; and when he was baptized he continued with Philip, and was amazed, seeing the miracles and signs which were done.

entries.title: Acts 8:14
segments: ¶Now when the apostles who were at Jerusalem heard that Samaria had received the word of God, they sent Peter and John to them,

entries.title: Acts 8:15
segments: who, when they had come down, prayed for them that they might receive the Holy Spirit.

entries.title: Acts 8:16
segments: For as yet He had fallen upon none of them. They had only been baptized in the name of the Lord Jesus.

entries.title: Acts 8:17
segments: Then they laid hands on them, and they received the Holy Spirit.

entries.title: Acts 8:18
segments: And when Simon saw that through the laying on of the apostles' hands the Holy Spirit was given, he offered them money,

entries.title: Acts 8:19
segments: saying, "Give me this power also, that anyone on whom I lay hands may receive the Holy Spirit."

entries.title: Acts 8:20
segments: But Peter said to him, "Your money perish with you, because you thought that the gift of God could be purchased with money!

entries.title: Acts 8:21
segments: "You have neither part nor portion in this matter, for your heart is not right in the sight of God.

entries.title: Acts 8:22
segments: "Repent therefore of this your wickedness, and pray God if perhaps the thought of your heart may be forgiven you.

entries.title: Acts 8:23
segments: "For I see that you are poisoned by bitterness and bound by iniquity."

entries.title: Acts 8:24
segments: Then Simon answered and said, "Pray to the Lord for me, that none of the things which you have spoken may come upon me."

entries.title: Acts 8:25
segments: So when they had testified and preached the word of the Lord, they returned to Jerusalem, preaching the gospel in many villages of the Samaritans.

entries.title: Acts 8:26
segments: ¶Now an angel of the Lord spoke to Philip, saying, "Arise and go toward the south along the road which goes down from Jerusalem to Gaza." This is desert.

entries.title: Acts 8:27
segments: So he arose and went. And behold, a man of Ethiopia, a eunuch of great authority under Candace the queen of the Ethiopians, who had charge of all her treasury, and had come to Jerusalem to worship,

entries.title: Acts 8:28
segments: was returning. And sitting in his chariot, he was reading Isaiah the prophet.

entries.title: Acts 8:29
segments: Then the Spirit said to Philip, "Go near and overtake this chariot."

entries.title: Acts 8:30
segments: So Philip ran to him, and heard him reading the prophet Isaiah, and said, "Do you understand what you are reading?"

entries.title: Acts 8:31
segments: And he said, "How can I, unless someone guides me?" And he asked Philip to come up and sit with him.

entries.title: Acts 8:32
segments: The place in the Scripture which he read was this: "He was led as a sheep to the slaughter; And as a lamb before its shearer [is] silent, So He opened not His mouth.

entries.title: Acts 8:33
segments: In His humiliation His justice was taken away, And who will declare His generation? For His life is taken from the earth."

entries.title: Acts 8:34
segments: So the eunuch answered Philip and said, "I ask you, of whom does the prophet say this, of himself or of some other man?"

entries.title: Acts 8:35
segments: Then Philip opened his mouth, and beginning at this Scripture, preached Jesus to him.

entries.title: Acts 8:36
segments: Now as they went down the road, they came to some water. And the eunuch said, "See, [here is] water. What hinders me from being baptized?"

entries.title: Acts 8:37
segments: Then Philip said, "If you believe with all your heart, you may." And he answered and said, "I believe that Jesus Christ is the Son of God."

entries.title: Acts 8:38
segments: So he commanded the chariot to stand still. And both Philip and the eunuch went down into the water, and he baptized him.

entries.title: Acts 8:39
segments: Now when they came up out of the water, the Spirit of the Lord caught Philip away, so that the eunuch saw him no more; and he went on his way rejoicing.

entries.title: Acts 8:40
segments: But Philip was found at Azotus. And passing through, he preached in all the cities till he came to Caesarea.
